long_biography.plain_text:
Tony Accurso led a Quebec construction group through Louisbourg and Simard-Beaudry. Its companies worked on roads, bridges, hydroelectric schemes, public buildings and municipal infrastructure, while related businesses supplied equipment, materials and waste services.

Investment from the Fonds de solidarité FTQ helped finance a vertically linked network. It paired major contractors with suppliers and property interests, giving the group reach beyond a single project type. Accurso retired after three decades of business leadership. A 2018 jury conviction for fraud, corruption and conspiracy was upheld on appeal, and the Supreme Court of Canada declined leave in 2023.
